_comment: Hand-curated return timetables, read by injury-returns.mjs. entries: { "<sleeper player_id>": { "kind": "team" | "report", "ret": "YYYY-MM-DD" (or "weeks": N | "season"), "source": "url or publisher", "checked": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "what was said" } }. kind "team" = the club's own timetable: it wins over everything and is not estimated. kind "report" (the default) = a media report: used only when ESPN has no return date and no timetable in its outlook; a dated report is not estimated, a weeks-only one is.
